scope: One read-only three-object collection against existing P4-1 test assets, then offline state evaluation; no new staging.
lifetime: Only the child process executing formal-r2; no global proxy/configuration change.

preparation.observation: Unauthenticated direct HEAD completed TLS and HTTP 400 in 1.150441 seconds, curl exit 0. This proves route reachability only, not credential or asset correctness.

preservation: V3 original assets are archived and separately retained as cloud/assets-v3-failed; no failure was overwritten.
stop_condition: Preserve any failure; no retry loop, no relaxed bytes/hash gate and no remote mutation.
